title: HopeLab app release config
description: hopelab-app.json at an app repository's root: what the shared release workflow builds and what the installers do. The "install" part is copied into every release's latest.json, so install.ps1 and install.sh need only the repository.

name.description: Display name, Windows install folder and Start menu entry: OneRing.

description.description: One line for the menu entry, Apps & features and the package.

project.description: The project published as the app (self-contained), relative to the repository.

icon.description: A .ico in the repository, for setup.exe.

png.description: A 256 px PNG in the repository, for the Linux menu entry.

aotProjects.description: Projects published over the top with NativeAOT (OneRing's ring CLI).

arguments.description: Extra dotnet test arguments, e.g. a --filter that skips a known hang.

depends.description: Debian Depends beyond the .NET runtime's own (ICU, OpenSSL, zlib, fontconfig).

setupAppId.description: Inno Setup AppId, a {GUID}. Never change it once released.

install.description: Copied into latest.json for the installers.

commands.description: Commands on PATH (Linux links): name -> executable in the app folder.

addToPath.description: Windows: put the app folder on the user PATH (for its CLI).

dataDirectory.description: The per-user data folder under the home folder, e.g. .onering; a saved GitHub token goes in github-token there.

dataDirectoryVariable.description: An environment variable that overrides it (ONERING_HOME).

tokenVariable.description: An app-specific GitHub token variable, checked before GH_TOKEN.

processes.description: Executables (no .exe) stopped before files are replaced.

stop.description: A clean stop to try first: an executable in the app folder and its arguments.

beforeUninstall.description: Run before removing the app (OneRing removes its login entry).

systemdUserUnit.description: A systemd --user unit to stop before and start after an update.

versionCommand.description: Prints the version (the release smoke test checks it): ["ring", "--version"].

updateCommand.description: Updates non-interactively from a terminal, for the smoke test: ["ring", "update", "--yes"].

firstRun.description: A sentence the installers print about the first launch.

uninstallNote.description: A sentence the installers print after uninstalling.
